title: ATEEZ Earn Fourth No. 1 on Billboard 200 With ‘GOLDEN HOUR : Part.6’
summary: Plus, U2 achieves its 14th top 10 with the debut of Carnaval de Luz.
body: ATEEZ earn their fourth No. 1 on the Billboard 200 albums chart as GOLDEN HOUR : Part.6 debuts atop the tally (dated Nov. 28). It’s the 10th top 10-charted project for the act, all of which have come since 2022. With the arrival, ATEEZ stand alone as the group with the most top 10s in the 2020s. Among all acts this decade, only YoungBoy Never Broke Again (15) and Taylor Swift (14) have more. Related During ATEEZ’s Biggest Year, Leader Hongjoong Wanted to Share a Song About Having ‘Enough’ Olivia Rodrigo’s ‘Stupid Song’ Hits No. 1 on Billboard’s Pop Airplay Chart Molly Meldrum, Australian Music Broadcaster and 'Countdown' Host, Dies at 83 GOLDEN HOUR : Part.6 bows with 195,000 equivalent album units earned in the United States in the week ending Nov. 19, largely driven by pure album sales (191,000). Also in the top 10, U2 collects its 14th top 10 as the band’s new studio album, Carnaval de Luz , debuts at No. 4. The Billboard 200 chart ranks the most popular albums of the week in the U.S. based on multi-metric consumption as measured in equivalent album units, compiled by Luminate.
